purpose: Challenge the selected Campaign037 mechanism against the complete terminal and prospective frontier before freezing a candidate formula or reading any value.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_five_minute_variance_ratio_230w
selected_mechanism.formula: For each 120-close half independently, form 119 adjacent log returns r_t, demean them within that half as e_t=r_t-mean(r), and form 115 overlapping five-return sums s_t=sum_{j=0}^4 e_{t+j}. Pool both halves and return mean(s_t^2)/(5*mean(e_t^2)), using 230 five-return sums and 238 demeaned one-minute returns.
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A higher fixed five-return variance ratio means signed one-minute innovations reinforce at a short multiscale horizon rather than cancel, which can represent persistent information incorporation relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_mechanism.selected_bar_grid: exactly 240 raw unadjusted one-minute closes at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 after frozen timestamp normalization; standalone 09:30 is excluded
selected_mechanism.return_rule: Form exactly 119 adjacent natural-log close returns independently inside each 120-close half. Never include the lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transition.
selected_mechanism.demeaning_rule: Subtract the arithmetic mean of the 119 signed returns separately within each half. Do not pool the half means, annualize, standardize, rank, or winsorize.
selected_mechanism.aggregation_rule: Within each half, form exactly 115 overlapping sums of five consecutive demeaned returns. Pool the two 115-element five-return-sum vectors only after construction.
selected_mechanism.variance_ratio_rule: Divide the population mean square of all 230 five-return sums by five times the population mean square of all 238 demeaned one-minute returns.
selected_mechanism.bar_rule: All 240 selected closes must be finite and strictly positive. Exact equal closes and exact-zero returns remain in the fixed support.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any invalid, nonpositive, or nonfinite selected close; any nonfinite return, demeaned return, or five-return sum; nonpositive one-minute mean-square denominator; nonfinite ratio; or ratio below zero makes the stock-day missing.

overlap_challenges.reason: The terminal diffusive-variation factor compares adjacent absolute-return products with realized squared variation to separate continuous and jump-like variation. Campaign037 instead aggregates signed demeaned returns over a fixed five-return horizon and measures reinforcement versus cancellation.
Campaign028 correlates adjacent absolute return magnitudes. Campaign037 retains signs, uses five-return overlapping sums, and has no absolute-return autocorrelation.
Campaign033 summarizes normalized DFT power across 59 frequencies. Campaign037 uses one predeclared time-domain five-return scale, no DFT, band selection, phase, or entropy.

Sign-run imbalance counts same-sign transitions and signed-path efficiency uses terminal displacement over total absolute travel. Campaign037 retains every return magnitude, removes each half's mean, has no count or terminal displacement, and measures multiscale variance.
Campaign037 has no equality count, weak-order state, tick-grid classification, or entropy. Exact-zero returns remain ordinary numeric observations.

Realized volatility measures return scale and volatility resolution allocates squared variation between halves. Campaign037 is scale-invariant, demeans each half, and compares five-return variance with one-return variance.
Campaign036 and the other range mechanisms read high and low geometry. Campaign037 reads neither high nor low and is determined only by the signed close-return path at a fixed aggregation scale.

Candidate49 counts close crossings around causal cumulative amount/volume VWAP and is future-only. Campaign037 reads no amount or volume, constructs no anchor or crossing, and remains historical-research-only.
Campaign037 contains no activity field, transaction price, peer benchmark, quarterly field, or event timing.
Campaign037 contains one exact close-only statistic and no terminal factor value, transform, filter, model, or combination.

decision.next_action: Freeze a fingerprint-bound no-return protocol with exactly this formula and the exact ordered 58-factor comparison library before implementing or opening any candidate value.
